landing.heroTitle: Keep inventory clear, keep teams aligned
landing.heroSubtitle: eMatChef supports storage, lending and visibility - for rental services and teams that stay organized.

intro.title: Organize digitally with ease
intro.paragraph1: Looking for a clear digital solution for materials, storage and lending? eMatChef is built for teams and rental operations: keep track of stock, locations and movements - without spreadsheet chaos or paper notes.
intro.paragraph2: The app runs in the browser, is role-based and can be customized per organization. Public QR info helps you find items again quickly.

items.title: Lending & stock

items.title: Templates & settings

departmentOnboarding.title: Department onboarding
departmentOnboarding.step1Intro: Add at least one department address (type {general} or {billing}).

departmentOnboarding.step6Intro: Create categories or use templates. You can extend this later in settings.

departmentOnboarding.step10Intro: Run a simple issue → return with recorded material once.
